Magnet Shimming System.name: Iron
Magnet Shimming System.reasoning: Iron is commonly used for passive shimming material due to its magnetic properties; standard choice.

Magnet Shimming System.name: Copper
Magnet Shimming System.reasoning: Copper may be used in active shimming coils for current conduction; not always used but common.

Magnet Shimming System.name: Aluminum

Rf Shielding Enclosure (faraday Cage).name: Copper
Rf Shielding Enclosure (faraday Cage).reasoning: Copper is the preferred material for constructing Faraday cages due to its excellent electrical conductivity and shielding effectiveness; essential.

Rf Shielding Enclosure (faraday Cage).name: Aluminum
Rf Shielding Enclosure (faraday Cage).reasoning: Aluminum is also used for RF shielding due to its conductivity and weight advantage; a common alternative.

Rf Shielding Enclosure (faraday Cage).name: Steel Ingots
Rf Shielding Enclosure (faraday Cage).reasoning: Steel can serve as a structural material and sometimes for RF shielding; less effective but used.

Rf Coil.name: Copper
Rf Coil.reasoning: Copper is the standard conductor material for radio frequency coils due to high conductivity and ease of fabrication; essential.

Rf Coil.name: Aluminum
Rf Coil.reasoning: Aluminum can be used in coil formers or secondary structural parts; not essential but common.

Rf Coil.name: Epoxy resins
Rf Coil.reasoning: Epoxy resins are used to insulate and structurally bind coil windings; common but alternatives exist.
